metadata.article_title: Liability for damage from want of repair.

article.title: Liability for damage from want of repair.
article.content: Where an easement is enjoyed by means of an artificial work, the dominant owner is liable to make compensation for any damage to the servient heritage arising from the want of repair of such work2.
article.html:
26Liability for damage from want of repair.

Section 26 · Chapter III · page 12 of the Act

Where an easement is enjoyed by means of an artificial work, the dominant owner is liable to make compensation for any damage to the servient heritage arising from the want of repair of such work2.

2 But see s. 50, infra, as to extinguishment or suspension of easement.
